titulo: Netanyahu pushes back against Gaza deal, saying will not withdraw from enclave
cuerpo: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has pushed back on a recent deal announced by US President Donald Trump for the disarmament of Hamas. In a video posted to social media, Netanyahu said the Israeli army would not pull back from its current positions in the Gaza Strip until the full disarmament of Hamas... comments that appear to contradict the terms of an October ceasefire deal. What exactly did Netanyahu say, and what could this mean going forward? Details by FRANCE 24 correspondent in Jerusalem, Noga Tarnopolsky.
